title: Standard dictionary for `govhr`
text: article describes standard dictionary govhr, organized four main modules: Establishment, Personnel, Contract, Allowance. modules designed organize standardize information public sector personnel across different countries administrative levels.

title: Standard dictionary for `govhr`
text: Establishment module captures information public sector institutions, including ministries, departments, agencies, along sector classification geographic/administrative location.

title: Standard dictionary for `govhr`
text: Sector: Uses COFOG (Classification Functions Government) classification categorize establishments. Administration vs. Geography: Administration levels (adm1/adm2/adm3) refer institutional/administrative divisions (e.g., Ministry, Department, Agency), geography levels (geo1/geo2) refer physical location (e.g., state/region, municipality/county).

title: Standard dictionary for `govhr`
text: Personnel module contains demographic employment information individual public sector employees.

title: Standard dictionary for `govhr`
text: Employment Status: Used together ref_date detect movement events hires, fires, retirements (see classify_personnel_event()). Educational Attainment: Follows World Bank’s Global Labor Database (GLD) 7-level classification convention. Tenure Fields: personnel_tenure tracks overall public sector tenure, distinct contract_tenure Contract module, tracks tenure within specific contract. Privacy Considerations: module contains sensitive personal information handled according applicable data protection regulations.

title: Standard dictionary for `govhr`
text: Contract module captures details employment contracts, compensation, job characteristics.

title: Standard dictionary for `govhr`
text: Compensation Fields: Base, gross, net salary fields (local currency ) allow analysis gross--net ratios effect deductions allowances. Itemized allowance amounts tracked separately Allowance module. Contract Type (International): Follows ILO’s ICSE-18 (International Classification Status Employment) standard cross-country comparability, contract_type_native preserves local terminology. Occupation Coding: native standardized (ISCO-08) classifications enable within-country detail cross-country comparability. Tenure vs. Seniority: contract_tenure tracks time worked current contract, seniority tracks level within paygrade.

title: Standard dictionary for `govhr`
text: Allowance module captures detailed, itemized allowance payments associated contract, allowing analysis allowance composition beyond aggregate allowance_lcu figure Contract module.

title: Standard dictionary for `govhr`
text: Granularity: Unlike aggregate allowance_lcu field Contract module, module stores one row per allowance type per contract per reference date, enabling detailed breakdowns allowance composition.

title: Standard dictionary for `govhr`
text: four modules related follows: One establishment can many contracts. One person can multiple contracts (time concurrent). One contract can multiple itemized allowances.
code: Establishment (1) ←→ (N) Contract Personnel (1) ←→ (N) Contract Contract (1) ←→ (N) Allowance

Constructs state label per person T0 (from_group) T1         (to_group) concatenating group_cols values         "||" separator. salary_col supplied, salary         first summed within person-group combination via         compute_fastsummary() handle multi-contract persons         state labels formed. Joins T0 T1 states person ID (inner join), persons         exit T0 T1 excluded transition counts. Counts transitions per (from_group, to_group) pair         divides T0 population from_group obtain         period-specific transition probability. title: Estimate Movement Baseline from Panel Data — estimate_movement_rates
text: data.table one row per   (from_group, to_group, from_period, to_period) transition pair,   keyed four columns. Returns empty data.table   schema valid transitions found. Columns: from_group Character. Concatenated group_cols state       start period (T0). to_group Character. Concatenated group_cols state       end period (T1). movement_rate Numeric. Empirical transition probability       specific period pair: \(n\_moves / n\_pop\). from_period Date. Snapshot date start period (T0). to_period Date. Snapshot date end period (T1). n_pop Integer. Number persons from_group T0. n_moves Integer. Number persons moved       from_group to_group T0 T1. salary_col NULL, five additional columns   appended: mean_salary_t0 Numeric. Mean salary from_group T0. mean_salary_t1 Numeric. Mean salary to_group T1. mean_salary_change Numeric. Absolute change mean salary       (T1 minus T0). median_salary_change Numeric. Median absolute salary change across       movers. mean_salary_pct_change Numeric. Mean percentage salary change       across movers.
